questions.question: What can a management group contain?
questions.explanation: Management groups contain subscriptions and child management groups.

questions.question: You apply an Azure Policy to a management group. Which resources are affected?

options.text: All subscriptions, resource groups and resources under it
No resources until each subscription opts in
Only resources created before the policy
options.why: Policies evaluate existing and new resources.

questions.explanation: Settings applied to a management group are inherited by everything below.

questions.question: How many parents can a subscription have in the management group hierarchy?

options.why: Each child has a single parent.
Each child has a single parent.

options.text: None. Subscriptions cannot be in management groups

questions.explanation: Each management group and subscription has exactly one parent.
